Hi there!

I'm Lindsay Rankin. 

I work in data science, data analysis, statistics, and research.

I have a PhD in social psychology with a quantitative methods concentration, where I focused on both experimental and survey research. After my formal education, I continued building my statistics and data skills, particularly a specialization in R programming.

Welcome, and see more [About](/about.qmd) me.
